items.desc: orange basketball with black lines

items.desc: white passenger jet airliner flying, three-quarter view

items.desc: red kangaroo standing upright on its strong hind legs with its long tail

items.desc: brass refracting telescope on a wooden tripod

items.desc: avocado cut in half with the brown pit in one half, next to the dark skinned whole fruit

items.desc: red farm tractor with big rear wheels and small front wheels, side view

items.desc: Atlantic puffin standing, black and white with a big orange and grey striped bill
